title: Principal splitting of a residue-exact pair
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, X,Y,Z finite free R-modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and a:X→Y, b:Y→Z with b∘a=0. Tensor products are [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Suppose the pair after tensoring with Frac(R/p) is exact at Y. There is f outside p and R_f-linear maps s:Y_f→X_f, t:Z_f→Y_f, where R_f is [def-weil-ring-localization-away], with a_f∘s∘a_f=a_f, t∘b_f∘t=t, a_f∘s+t∘b_f=1, and both ker(s∘a_f) and ker(b_f∘t) free over R_f.

proof.text: Identify the residue field of R_p with Frac(R/p) using uniqueness of fraction fields. The tensor-change equivalences commute with a and b. The natural scalar-extension composition isomorphism then transfers exactness to the residue of the pair over R_p.

source.place: Tag 068U, lemma-cut-complex-in-two, the direct proof and the three adjacent direct-sum decompositions

proof.text: Put the pair over R_p in the bounded three-term complex in degrees -1,0,1. Apply the already proved CochainComplex.exists_homotopyEquiv_isMinimal from WeilConjectures.Algebra.Homology.MinimalComplex. Its residue differentials are zero. Homotopy equivalence preserves residue homology. Exactness at zero implies its middle residue module is zero, and Nakayama implies that its middle module itself is zero.

source.place: Tag 068U, lemma-cut-complex-in-two, the direct proof and the three adjacent direct-sum decompositions

proof.text: Read the homotopy identity in degree zero. The negative homotopy components give maps s,t with sA+Bt=1. From BA=0, precompose the identity by A to get AsA=A, and postcompose it by B to get BtB=B. Replace t by tBt; this makes tBt=t and retains sA+Bt=1. All support bounds and zero-rank cases are handled by the bounded complex construction.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_localized_exact_pair_contraction
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (X Y Z : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (a : X ⟶ Y) (b : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hab : a ≫ b = 0)
    (hX : Module.Free R X) (hY : Module.Free R Y) (hZ : Module.Free R Z)
    (hfX : Module.Finite R X) (hfY : Module.Finite R Y) (hfZ : Module.Finite R Z)
    (hexact : Function.Exact
      ((extendScalars.{u, u, max u v}
        ((algebraMap (R ⧸ p) (FractionRing (R ⧸ p))).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p))).map a).hom
      ((extendScalars.{u, u, max u v}
        ((algebraMap (R ⧸ p) (FractionRing (R ⧸ p))).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p))).map b).hom) :
    ∃ f : R, f ∉ p ∧
      let E := extendScalars.{u, u, max u v} (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f))
      ∃ (s : E.obj Y ⟶ E.obj X) (t : E.obj Z ⟶ E.obj Y),
        E.map a ≫ s ≫ E.map a = E.map a ∧
        t ≫ E.map b ≫ t = t ∧
        s ≫ E.map a + E.map b ≫ t = 𝟙 (E.obj Y) ∧
        Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (LinearMap.ker (E.map a ≫ s).hom) ∧
        Module.Free (Localization.Away f) (LinearMap.ker (t ≫ E.map b).hom)
